community.name: IslandWalk
community.roll: Sarasota County 2026 certified roll, obtained 11 September 2026
community.cdd_note: West Villages Improvement District. On one verified 2026 TRIM notice from IslandWalk the district assessment was $563 a year, and the whole non-ad valorem side, including North Port fire, solid waste and drainage, was $1,412. That is one parcel, not an average, and the amount varies by phase and bond series. IslandWalk is an earlier phase than Gran Paradiso and its district charge on that notice was far lower.
